name: CT Real Estate Investment Trust
summary: CT Real Estate Investment Trust is an unincorporated, closed-end real estate investment trust formed to own income producing commercial properties located primarily in Canada. Its portfolio is comprised of 380 properties totaling 32 million square feet of GLA, consisting primarily of net lease single-tenant retail properties located across Canada. Canadian Tire Corporation, Limited is CT REIT's most significant tenant. CT Real Estate Investment Trust was established on October 22, 2013 and incorporated in Ontario, Canada.
